name: external-review-profiles
description: Pinned external review provider profile for Claude Bridge and Antigravity Bridge.

interface.longDescription: External Review Profiles is a parent/profile repository that pins Claude Bridge and Antigravity Bridge as external review providers. It does not auto-install nested plugins; install the provider plugins separately or run their submodule helpers directly. Use Claude Bridge by default and opt into Antigravity only when explicitly requested or when a small high-risk scope justifies its limited token budget.
defaultPrompt: Use Claude Bridge to review my local changes.
Use Antigravity Bridge only when I explicitly request it or provide a small high-risk scope.
